$comment: THE KIT'S INTEGRATION CONTRACT — the single machine-readable declaration of everything an
integrator has to get right to point this fork at a real Purple gateway. Six documents used
to restate this by hand (README, .env.example, AGENT-BRIEF.md, the bundled SKILL.md, the
welcome pack, and the code itself); every one of them had drifted from at least one of the
others. This file is the source, `scripts/spec-contract.mjs` is the projector, and CI is the
wall. Change the truth HERE and let the checks tell you which document has not caught up.
It is deliberately a data file with no prose obligations of its own: anything stated here is
asserted against the kit's code, its env template, and its published docs on every CI run.
It is also a PUBLIC, stable artifact of a public repo — the welcome-pack composer on the
platform side can fetch it and assert its own manifest against these names rather than

apiBase.convention: origin + the published version prefix, no trailing slash — paste the welcome pack's value as-is

pageHostBases.convention: origin only — no version prefix, no path, no trailing slash (the opposite convention from the API base)

wireEffect.note: sent on every live gateway call — a fork that leaves the demo default set authenticates as one tenant while asserting another

claims.ruling: Architect, WI-374: the PUBLIC entry-mode pair is question-first / pay-first. The kit's funnelMode CODE values (quiz-first | buy-first) are FROZEN — renaming them breaks every fork — so the README must carry one sentence mapping the two vocabularies.
Architect, WI-374: journey_id is the FROZEN wire name and "enrollment" the public prose noun. The reconciling sentence is mandatory wherever the wire field first appears in reader-facing prose.

$minimaComment: NON-VACUITY FLOOR. A checker that examines nothing passes everything — that is the exact
shape of a fail-closed gate that has silently jammed. Every check declares how many things it
examined and reds if the census falls below its floor, so 'the scanner stopped seeing call
sites' can never read as 'the call sites are all fine'.
$jamComment: JAM DETECTION. A fail-closed gate that stops ruling is worse than one that goes red, because
nothing says so. `spec-contract-live` runs on kit main AND on a daily schedule; the PR-time
check asserts that a live verification concluded successfully inside this window. Past the
window the verdict is JAMMED — reported as loudly as DRIFT, and never as a pass.
$bootstrapComment: The grace window between this instrument landing and its first successful live run. It is a
DATE, not a flag, so it cannot be left on: after it, 'no live verification has ever succeeded'
is a jam like any other.
